subject: The truth about why I almost quit building this app
preview_text: A confession about what almost stopped me, and why you changed everything. This is for you.
body_paragraphs: I was sitting there, staring at the code, ready to delete the whole project. I thought, 'Who am I to think I can solve this? No one will care.' The weight of it—the confusion, the guilt, the worry—felt too big for one app.

Honestly, building PupShape wouldn't mean anything without people like you. Every time I see a 'progress logged' notification or a new before/after photo, it's a reminder. You're not just using an app. You're choosing a longer, happier life for your best friend. That's the only reason this exists.

That's why the photo timeline feature is my favorite. It's not just pictures. It's the story of your dog getting their spark back. It's the proof that the confusing puzzle of pet nutrition has an answer, and you're holding it.

Will you open the app right now and add a new photo to your dog's timeline? Even if it's just from this week. Let's lock in this chapter of their healthier life. P.S. The next milestone notification is programmed to celebrate you specifically. Don't miss it.
cta_text: Open PupShape & Add a Progress Photo
